title: Continuous and compact embeddings for a class of modular sequence spaces
summary: In this article we prove the existence of continuous and compact embeddings for a class of modular sequence spaces generated by Orlicz functions. The class under consideration contains sequence spaces of Orlicz-Sobolev type, including certain special cases that have played an important role in a number of applications regarding problems arising in non-equilibrium statistical mechanics, as well as Nakano's class of Lebesgue sequence spaces with variable exponents.
